question: Agent-reported issue 2: 10 parallel headless hosts crashed one .NET host with 0x800705AA (ERROR_NO_SYSTEM_RESOURCES); 8 were fine.
measurement: One Debug TrafficHost on simulator 2026-11-08.2, LosAngeles seed 7, reference roads re-sent each 400-tick step, until game-over at 376 s (54 trips, 16 cars, ~53 KB per step reply).
conclusion: Per-host footprint is small and flat (handles and threads constant). Ten hosts need roughly 0.6 GB and ~1,800 handles; nothing in the host scales with the number of processes. The cause is most likely a machine/session limit (commit memory, or desktop heap from many console processes), not a host defect. Not reproduced: no 10-host run was attempted.
